selection_reason: Fresh authenticated GitHub audit found D3DTOP_BLENDCURRENTALPHA remained unsupported after retained BLENDDIFFUSEALPHA work. Microsoft Direct3D 9 semantics define BLENDCURRENTALPHA as Arg1*previous-stage-alpha + Arg2*(1-previous-stage-alpha); generated HLSL evaluates nextColor/nextAlpha before assigning current, so current.a is the required previous-stage factor.
